mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the FEDFUNDS trigger does not precede negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and rising UNRATE (higher unemployment) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not significantly predict positive returns (p > 0.05) or the combined signal's effect is nullified in the data.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the CPIAUCSL decline does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05) or the regime is not identified.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO (supply) combined with falling FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rising and FEDFUNDS falling over 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction does not significantly predict positive returns (p > 0.05) or the signals are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (employment) alongside a persistent UNRATE above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The combined labor signals do not precede negative returns (p > 0.05) or the trigger is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The trend reverses or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in RSAFS (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The RSAFS decline does not correlate with positive returns in post-shock regimes (p > 0.05) or the regime is not active.
